claim: A spacetime metric can carry a compact region effectively faster than light without local superluminal motion.
result: Valid exact-metric construction; no known mechanism to create it; original form requires negative energy and faces causality/stability constraints.
status: Mathematical model, not technology
common_error: Treating a solution of Einstein's equations as an engineering design or source mechanism.
correction: Require a realizable stress-energy tensor, formation dynamics, stability, control and total-energy accounting.

claim: Strong magnetic-field gradients can levitate water-rich matter, including living organisms.
result: Experimentally established levitation that balances gravity with magnetic force; gravity is unchanged.
status: Established, not anti-gravity
common_error: Calling force balance 'gravity cancellation'.
correction: Measure and report magnetic force and field gradient; reserve anti-gravity for changes to gravitational interaction.

claim: Rotating RF-driven YBCO may reduce weight above the apparatus.
result: Mechanistic discussion only; the underlying effect remained unsubstantiated by reliable independent replication.
status: Unconfirmed
common_error: Building theory around an unverified anomaly.
correction: First reproduce a blinded weight change with environmental controls before proposing a gravity mechanism.

claim: A rotating superconducting disk produces percent-level weight loss above it.
result: Claimed effect; no robust independent confirmation and later precision tests constrained comparable effects.
status: Not established
common_error: Insufficient control of vibration, airflow, magnetic coupling, tare drift and selective reporting.
correction: Use dual balances, magnetic shielding, dummy rotors, randomized states and preregistered analysis.

claim: Superconducting transitions or rotation might change weight.
result: No anomaly within experimental accuracy; claimed transition-related effects were ruled out at the tested scale.
status: Null result
common_error: Ignoring null results when reviewing sensational positive claims.
correction: Use null constraints to define the remaining allowed parameter space.

claim: Asymmetric high-voltage capacitors produce electro-gravitic thrust.
result: Observed atmospheric thrust is consistent with corona/ion wind; claimed vacuum anti-gravity was not confirmed.
status: Conventional mechanism
common_error: Testing in residual gas without quantifying ion momentum or outgassing.
correction: Use high vacuum, sealed electrode assembly, current diagnostics and polarity/pressure scaling.

claim: Electromagnetic, quantum-vacuum and relativistic routes might permit gravity control.
result: Useful taxonomy and test concepts; no demonstrated controllable gravity source.
status: Conceptual
common_error: Conflating measurement concepts with achieved control.
correction: Assign technology-readiness separately from theoretical consistency.

claim: Inhomogeneous electric fields produce a mass-dependent anomalous force.
result: Tantalizing preliminary signal, not independently established.
status: Unconfirmed
common_error: Force gradients, charge leakage and electrostatic coupling can mimic mass dependence.
correction: Faraday enclosure, charge monitoring, field reversal, dummy loads and independent replication.

claim: Accelerating cryogenic rings generate anomalously large frame-dragging-like fields.
result: Initial signals were controversial and comparable independent measurements were null or inconclusive.
status: Unconfirmed
common_error: Mechanical vibration, helium flow, sensor coupling and rotation-correlated backgrounds.
correction: Remote sensors, noncryogenic controls, multiple gyroscope technologies and blinded rotation sequences.

claim: Systematically assess gravity shielding, reactionless propulsion and spacetime concepts.
result: Found gravity-shielding claims unsubstantiated and emphasized independent validation and energy accounting.
status: Authoritative review
common_error: Comparing claims by novelty instead of testability and evidence.
correction: Use explicit success criteria, null hypotheses and independent replication gates.

claim: A disciplined framework can evaluate mechanical anti-gravity proposals.
result: Defines constructive screening and experiment-design practices rather than validating a device.
status: Methodological advance
common_error: Either dismissing before measurement or accepting anomalous readings without artifact closure.
correction: Use staged falsification, calibration and effect-size thresholds.

claim: Driven capacitors undergo transient mass fluctuations yielding net thrust.
result: Claimed micro-newton signals remain disputed; later high-sensitivity investigations rejected the proposed mass fluctuations/thrust.
status: Not established
common_error: Thermal expansion, cable forces, vibration and phase-correlated drift at the signal scale.
correction: Wireless power or symmetric feeds, vacuum, thermal twins, impulse calibration and independent blind analysis.

claim: A spin-orbit-coupled condensate exhibits negative effective mass dynamics.
result: Established band-dispersion effect; it is not negative gravitational mass and does not repel ordinary gravity.
status: Established analogue
common_error: Dropping the qualifier 'effective' and inferring anti-gravity.
correction: Keep inertial, effective, passive-gravitational and active-gravitational mass distinct.

claim: Entanglement between nearby masses could witness nonclassical gravitational mediation.
result: Influential experimental proposals; not gravity control and not yet a completed decisive test.
status: Proposed experiment
common_error: Presenting a proposed witness as an observed quantum-gravity effect.
correction: State the inference assumptions and competing mediator models before defining the success criterion.

claim: A mediator able to entangle two quantum systems must itself have noncommuting observables.
result: Important information-theoretic proposal; later work clarifies model-dependence and locality assumptions.
status: Proposed experiment
common_error: Overstating what entanglement alone proves about a full quantum theory of gravity.
correction: Preregister which classical/semi-classical alternatives the experiment excludes.

claim: Positive-energy subluminal warp geometries can be described within general relativity.
result: Advances classification of warp geometries but does not provide a propulsion mechanism; superluminal generic drives remain constrained.
status: Mathematical model
common_error: Equating positive local energy density with practical or superluminal feasibility.
correction: Separate subluminal geometry, superluminal claims, energy conditions and formation/control requirements.

claim: Hyper-fast solitons may exist with positive energy sources in Einstein-Maxwell-plasma theory.
result: Contested theoretical construction; subsequent analyses find generic energy-condition violations or restrictive assumptions.
status: Disputed mathematical proposal
common_error: Checking one energy component while overlooking all energy conditions and global construction.
correction: Audit the complete stress-energy tensor in orthonormal frames and evaluate formation/stability.

claim: Recently proposed physically reasonable warp drives avoid exotic matter.
result: Analysis concludes generic warp drives violate the null energy condition.
status: Constraint/null feasibility
common_error: Selective energy-condition tests and coordinate-dependent interpretations.
correction: Use invariant/orthonormal-frame checks across the full spacetime.

claim: Different materials may fall at measurably different rates.
result: No violation; universality of free fall constrained to about one part in 10^15 for the tested materials.
status: High-precision null result
common_error: Treating absence of anomaly as no advance.
correction: Use stronger null bounds to eliminate anti-gravity models that imply composition-dependent coupling.

claim: A closed microwave cavity produces propellantless thrust above photon pressure.
result: High-accuracy testing traced apparent thrust to false-positive effects and found no anomalous thrust at the claimed scale.
status: Null result
common_error: Thermal center-of-mass shifts, cable/magnetic coupling and balance tilt.
correction: Rotate device geometry, use null loads, photon-thrust calibration, symmetric feeds and thermal modeling.

claim: Antihydrogen might fall upward and provide anti-gravity.
result: Antihydrogen was observed to fall downward; large repulsive gravity is excluded, with precision still improving.
status: Major confirmed advance; no anti-gravity
replication: 2024 run reported consistent by CERN program review
common_error: Equating antimatter with negative mass and interpreting uncertainty as evidence of upward fall.
correction: Fit the gravitational acceleration with magnetic-systematic nuisance parameters and report sign confidence.

claim: BMV entanglement uniquely proves quantized gravity.
result: Shows the inference depends on locality and mediator assumptions; narrows what a positive test would establish.
status: Interpretive correction
common_error: Ignoring alternative nonlocal or hybrid models.
correction: Define the model class excluded, not the slogan 'gravity is quantum'.

claim: Capacitors, coils or other steady EM systems may generate anomalous weight, force or torque.
result: No anomalous forces or torques found using shielded high-vacuum precision balances.
status: Null result
common_error: Unshielded magnetic/electrostatic interactions and environmental drift.
correction: Adopt shielded multi-axis balances and publish device-specific upper bounds.

topic: Gravity measured with levitated milligram mass
claim: Levitated systems can detect extremely weak gravitational coupling.
result: Measured gravitational coupling between a levitated submillimeter magnetic particle and kilogram source masses; improves sensing, not gravity control.
status: Confirmed metrology advance
common_error: Confusing a magnetically levitated detector with anti-gravity.
correction: Explicitly distinguish the suspension force from the gravitational signal channel.

claim: Warp metrics can be systematically evaluated for stress-energy and energy-condition violations.
result: Useful open numerical framework; analyses still find violations in studied superluminal-type solutions.
status: Methodological advance
common_error: Treating numerical visualization as proof of physical realizability.
correction: Validate tensors analytically on benchmarks and publish convergence/error tests.

claim: Mach-effect devices yield thrust from transient mass fluctuations.
result: High-sensitivity investigation rejected the claimed mass fluctuations and thrust.
status: Null result
common_error: Signals covary with thermal/mechanical transients and wiring forces.
correction: Require force persistence after artifact regression and cross-laboratory replication.

claim: High-purity levitated motion can support future tests of quantum gravity.
result: Improved oscillator control and state purity; no anti-gravity or gravity modification observed.
status: Enabling technology
common_error: Calling a platform for future gravity tests a gravity breakthrough.
correction: Label readiness milestones separately from gravitational results.

claim: ALPHA-g result may be refined and independently complemented by AEgIS/GBAR.
result: Reports downward antihydrogen acceleration at about 20% precision and a consistent 2024 ALPHA run; AEgIS/GBAR remain precision pathways.
status: Ongoing confirmed program
common_error: Calling planned precision improvements evidence for anomalous antimatter gravity.
correction: Track achieved measurements separately from projected sensitivities.

claim: A low-noise milligram oscillator can approach gravity-mediated quantum tests.
result: Advances mechanical sensitivity and isolation; no anti-gravity effect reported.
status: Enabling technology
common_error: Converting sensitivity forecasts into discovery claims.
correction: Report demonstrated noise floors, integration times and unblinded versus blinded stages.

claim: Local negative energy density is allowed by quantum field theory and may enable exotic spacetime engineering.
result: Negative energy is locally possible but quantum inequalities tightly restrict magnitude and duration; no macroscopic controllable source exists.
status: Established theory with strong constraints
common_error: Scaling microscopic sub-vacuum energy to arbitrary macroscopic negative mass.
correction: Apply quantum inequalities and include apparatus, boundary and total stress-energy.
